story.title: Story 3: The Adapter and the Seven Prompts

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on SV-03-001 and directly touched surfaces. The adapter now keeps bounded tool-result content within maxInputChars when the truncation marker cannot fit, coverage was added for the counterexample, focused tests passed, and both configured gates passed.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by src/inference/adapter.ts:30-42: when marker.length > maxInputChars, boundContent now returns content.slice(0, maxInputChars) instead of emitting an over-budget marker; otherwise it keeps the head + marker + tail path under the cap. test/inference-prompts.test.ts:241-266 adds the small-bound regression case. A direct reproduction over maxInputChars values 10, 40, 75, and 200 produced output lengths equal to the cap, and the focused suite passed 26 tests.

verified: AC-2.2 / TC-2.2: oversized summarizeToolResult input remains bounded under maxInputChars for both the normal marker-fitting case and the marker-too-large counterexample.
TC-2.1 / AC-2.1, AC-2.2, AC-2.5: inference-adapter.test.ts remains green in the focused run.
TC-2.3 / AC-2.4: empty-output retry and exhaustion coverage remains green in the focused run.
Configured story gate passed: pnpm run verify.
Configured epic gate passed: pnpm run verify-all.

gatesRun.command: cd packages/lhc && pnpm exec vitest run test/inference-adapter.test.ts test/inference-prompts.test.ts

additionalObservations: Focused Story 3 tests now report 26 passing tests; full suite reports 353 passing tests.
No fake adapter, shim, placeholder, or non-real production execution path was introduced in the touched inference adapter path.
